text:
marta: Quick heads-up — ship day ops schedule below. Need clear owners for: version bump, changelog final sweep, QA gate lead, security sign-off, docs publish. Please confirm if you own any. Planned timeline: freeze at 16:00 UTC, smoke at 17:30, QA bridge at 17:20, canary at 18:00, full cut at 19:00. Also we need a hotfix/rollback contingency and phone tree.

kevin: I can own smoke + canary runs. Will run the smoke playbook and post results to #incidents.

jasper: I will take version bump + changelog. Pushing branch release/v0.23.0-bump in ~10m.

sara: I can do docs publish. Quick question: do we still need the API crosslink for the new pagination change? If yes, send PRs here.

lin: Security review — I'll run a quick secret-scan and SCA now. ETA ~30m. Any new infra changes included in this release? If not, should be straightforward.

marta: Thanks — jasper, remember to update the CHANGELOG header with migration notes and call out the deprecation. Kevin, please coordinate QA bridge link.

jasper: Pushing tag now: `git tag -a v0.23.0 -m "release v0.23.0" && git push origin v0.23.0`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window reserved 19:00-19:30 UTC. To start deploy when ready, comment `/deploy start release/v0.23.0@prod`.

kevin: Noted. I'll spin up the QA bridge at 17:20 UTC. link: https://meet.example/qa-bridge

sara: :thumbsup: Docs PRs queued: #1234 (API crosslink), #1235 (migration guide). I'll merge after lin's sign-off.

lin: SCA/secret-scan clean. No new findings; security sign-off from me.

marta: Small contingency note: if p99 latency > 2s after canary, fallback to v0.22.9. Kevin, verify autoscaler & fallback route before canary.

kevin: Will monitor metrics and have rollback playbook ready. Ping me here and on the bridge if anything looks off.

jasper: Done: branch merged, changelog updated, tag pushed. Found one flaky test — quarantining `test_integration_stream`, filing ticket ENG-3312.

marta: Solid. Final ask: owners, please post confirmations in this thread in the next 15m so I can lock the freeze at 16:00 UTC as promised. :rocket:
